prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production JRPG walking sprite sheet.
Primary request: Redraw the reference character as a TRUE GROUNDED WALK CYCLE with FOUR DISTINCT successive walking poses for each of EIGHT directions. The reference supplies character identity, outfit and illustration style only. REPLACE its old square 4-by-4 layout and airborne/jogging poses with the exact new layout below.
Canvas: landscape 2:1, 2048 x 1024 pixels. Exactly 8 COLUMNS x 4 ROWS = 32 equal SQUARE cells, each 256 x 256 pixels, invisible grid. One complete character per cell, entire body and accessories visible, 8–12 percent clear margins all around. No cell overlaps or cropping. Identical scale in all cells; upright two-head-tall chibi proportions.
Exact direction and cell order, left to right:
ROW 1 cells 1,2,3,4: E (right profile) walking poses A,B,C,D. Cells 5,6,7,8: SE (front three-quarter facing down-right) poses A,B,C,D.
ROW 2 cells 1,2,3,4: S (straight front view) poses A,B,C,D. Cells 5,6,7,8: SW (front three-quarter facing down-left) poses A,B,C,D.
ROW 3 cells 1,2,3,4: W (left profile) poses A,B,C,D. Cells 5,6,7,8: NW (rear three-quarter facing up-left) poses A,B,C,D.
ROW 4 cells 1,2,3,4: N (straight back view, NO face visible) poses A,B,C,D. Cells 5,6,7,8: NE (rear three-quarter facing up-right) poses A,B,C,D.
Walking cycle: A = left leg forward making ground contact, right leg behind, right arm forward. B = planted left leg vertically bearing weight as right leg swings closely past it, arms passing toward neutral. C = right leg forward making ground contact, left leg behind, left arm forward. D = planted right leg vertically bearing weight as left leg swings closely past it, arms passing toward neutral. Alternate the LEFT and RIGHT legs and opposite arms visibly, with obvious passing-leg poses B and D. Legs must NOT merely repeat the same forward foot with different arms.
Every frame MUST have at least ONE foot visibly flat or naturally heel/toe planted at the SAME imaginary contact baseline near 90 percent of cell height. No both-feet-in-air poses. Short modest steps, low foot clearance, mostly straight support knee, relaxed arm swing, upright body, level head. Do not draw the imaginary baseline. This is grounded casual WALKING, never running/jogging, jumping, hopping, flying or dangling.
Style: preserve soft painted JRPG illustration, crisp fine dark contours, warm gentle dimensional shading and expressive friendly character identity from reference.
Background: ONLY sprites on fully opaque perfectly uniform pure #FF00FF MAGENTA chroma-key background. No transparency. No text, labels, numbers, gridlines, borders, floor, ground shadows, effects, scenery or props besides the character's existing worn accessories.
Input image 1 is the identity reference: keep this same green explorer with brown shaggy hair, big brown eyes, cream pith helmet with brown band and a green leaf accent, green neckerchief, olive green utility vest, cream shirt, tan shorts, cream socks, brown hiking boots and small brown backpack with brass buckle. Preserve all outfit colors and details.
